metric_definitions.ambiguity_rule: Test-fold decisions the ambiguity rule moved from auto_accept to review because the top-2 probability gap was below the gap threshold.
metric_definitions.at_auto_accept_or_review: The same figures if every review were resolved correctly: a review row counts as correct when any of its candidates is in the truth set. An upper bound.
metric_definitions.calibration: decision_level: ten equal-width bins over the top candidate's probability of labelled test A records, with the observed rate of correct top candidates; pair_level: the same over every labelled test-fold pair. ECE is the count-weighted mean absolute gap; Brier the mean squared error of the probability against the label.
metric_definitions.confusion: Pair-level counts over labelled test-fold pairs at each tier boundary: tp and fp are pairs at or above the boundary, fn and tn below.
metric_definitions.coverage: Auto-accepted A records divided by all A records in the test fold, labelled or not. A volume measure, not an accuracy measure.
metric_definitions.coverage_all_folds: Auto-accepted A records divided by all sampled A records across every fold. Not an accuracy measure.
metric_definitions.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall_labelled at the same tier boundary.
metric_definitions.labelled_a: Labelled A records in the test fold: those with an in-sample truth link.
metric_definitions.labelled_a_reachable: Labelled test-fold A records whose truth survived blocking: at least one candidate pair is a truth pair.
metric_definitions.pair_completeness_test: labelled_a_reachable divided by labelled_a: the share of labelled test A records whose truth blocking made reachable (A-level pair completeness).
metric_definitions.precision: Among test-fold A records the method accepted, the share whose accepted B is in the A record's truth set. Over labelled A records only.
metric_definitions.recall_labelled: Correct accepts divided by labelled_a_reachable. Recall against labelled pairs whose truth blocking made reachable; unlinked is not non-match.
metric_definitions.recall_overall: Correct accepts divided by labelled_a: recall with the blocking loss included; equals recall_labelled times pair_completeness_test exactly.
metric_definitions.tier_shares: Share of all test-fold A records in each tier; an A record with no candidate is reject. The three shares sum to one.
metric_definitions.unverified_accepts: Auto-accepts on unlabelled test-fold A records: counted by coverage, not by the accuracy metrics. share_of_accepts is their share of all test-fold auto-accepts.
